description: Department of National Zoological Gardens - The Rates of the entrance tickets of Pinnawala Zoo commencing from 01.05.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new entrance fee rates for the Pinnawala Zoo under the authority of the National Zoological Gardens Act. It constitutes a regulatory matter that sets compliance requirements for visitors, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure matter (Types 1-3) or any other specialized category.
